title: Not as bright
text: Not as bright. So overall, I was disappointed in these. I liked one of them - the one that was very colorful. That one was bright and vibrant and very pretty. The others were really just so so. One of them really seemed faded. They just weren't close to as vibrant as the pictures. I will hang the one becuase I like it, but probably not the others. Otherwise they seem okay as far as being solid.
